data.value: Estimated from system volume and device type, not a calibrated sound-pressure-level measurement - Windows has no API for that on arbitrary hardware.

data.name: Help_EstimatesListeningLevelFromSystem
data.value: Estimates listening level from the system audio meter — it never records or listens to actual audio. The WHO suggests staying under 85 dB; the default harmful threshold is 75 dB. Bars over 75 dB are shown in red.

data.name: Help_EverythingStaysDeviceNoAccount
data.value: Everything stays on this device — no account, no cloud, no telemetry. Website tracking is off by default — if you turn it on, only the hostname (e.g. youtube.com) is stored, never full URLs or page content. Export your data as CSV or delete it all from Settings at any time.

data.name: Help_FocusSessionsWatchEntertainmentApps
data.value: Focus sessions watch for Entertainment apps. Warn shows a notification; Block minimizes them. Pulse can also follow Windows Focus sessions when enabled in Settings. Wind Down adds a gentle scheduled border when it's time to wrap up.

data.name: Help_Follows202020Rule
data.value: Follows the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Snooze up to 3 times; the timer resets after 5 minutes away. Reminders appear over Pulse, or as a notification when Pulse is in the notification area.

data.name: Help_LaunchWindowsStartupRunsQuietly
data.value: Launch on Windows startup runs quietly in the notification area. Back up now creates a local ZIP containing your database and settings. Restore replaces current local data, so make a fresh backup first and review the confirmation carefully.

data.name: Help_RecordsWhichAppHasFocus
data.value: Records which app has focus and for how long while you're using the PC. After 5 minutes without input it stops, unless that app is fullscreen or playing audio. Clicking the desktop or taskbar doesn't count as File Explorer. App names are stored, but window titles are never saved to the database for privacy. Categorize apps as Work, Entertainment or Neutral for Focus.

data.name: Help_SetDailyAllowanceUnavailableHours
data.value: Set a daily allowance, unavailable hours, or both for an app. Remind sends a notification when the limit is reached; Block also minimizes the app. Pause or edit a limit anytime from the Limits page.

data.name: Help_ShowsOneWeekTimeMonday
data.value: Shows one week at a time (Monday to Sunday); use the arrows to browse earlier weeks. Includes screen-time trends, top apps, focus completion and sound levels. Week-over-week comparisons show whether your habits are improving; focus vs. leisure shows how productive your time was.

data.name: Help_SummaryDayHeroStatTotal
data.value: The summary of your day. The hero stat is total active screen time — time spent actively using your PC. Time away isn't counted. Tinted cards preview each section and link straight to it.

data.name: Help_TracksHowLongActivelyUse
data.value: Tracks how long you actively use your PC. After 5 minutes without mouse or keyboard input it pauses, unless audio is playing or an app is fullscreen (for example, a video). Locking or sleeping the PC pauses it too. The timeline shows your day; the weekly view shows daily totals.
